allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Make email operations non-blocking to prevent request timeouts

- Changed ticket assignment email to non-blocking with error handling
- Changed ticket creation email to non-blocking 
- Changed status update email in PUT endpoint to non-blocking
- Changed user welcome email to non-blocking
- Added logger import to user.controller.js for error logging

This fixes timeout issues when emails are slow, allowing responses to return
immediately after database operations complete while emails send in the background.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

statusLine.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input = $input | Out-String; $data = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $totalUsed = $data.context_window.total_input_tokens + $data.context_window.total_output_tokens; $sessionBudget = 200000; $weeklyBudget = 1000000; $weeklyUsed = $totalUsed; $sessionPct = [Math]::Round(($totalUsed / $sessionBudget) * 100, 1); $weeklyPct = [Math]::Round(($weeklyUsed / $weeklyBudget) * 100, 1); $sFilled = [Math]::Floor(($sessionPct / 100) * 20); $sBar = ('█' * $sFilled) + ('░' * (20 - $sFilled)); $wFilled = [Math]::Floor(($weeklyPct / 100) * 20); $wBar = ('█' * $wFilled) + ('░' * (20 - $wFilled)); function Format-Tokens($n) { if ($n -ge 1000000) { '{0:N1}M' -f ($n/1000000) } elseif ($n -ge 1000) { '{0:N1}K' -f ($n/1000) } else { $n } }; $sUsed = Format-Tokens $totalUsed; $sBudget = Format-Tokens $sessionBudget; $wUsed = Format-Tokens $weeklyUsed; $wBudget = Format-Tokens $weeklyBudget; Write-Host \"Session: [$sBar] $sUsed/$sBudget ($sessionPct%) | Weekly: [$wBar] $wUsed/$wBudget ($weeklyPct%)\" -NoNewline"
